## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1], model agreement, and suggested superior/inferior margin involvement [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Concentrated on invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 0.1, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 96% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (100%, similarity 0.77–0.86) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 3, 4, 11) · context · Above typical (1.35); lowers score (-1.07) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical (-0.68); scarcity raises score (+1.02) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (+1.93); raises score (+1.00) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below typical (-1.03); scarcity raises score (+0.91) · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (+1.07); raises score (+0.74) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful across dataset (deletion drop +0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197 excludes 0); all 12 case regions score 1.0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- **In situ mimicry**: Contrast case BACH_0253 is InSitu (0.74 similarity), differing in benign stroma and Unreliable normal lobules.
- **Frozen-section artifact**: Severity-3 resample degradation and 96% OOD percentile distort morphology (reliability AUROC 70% on simulated frozen sections).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 5**: Confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism (Validated); verify mitoses directly (concept is Unreliable).
2. **Regions 6, 7, 8**: Rule out duct-confined in situ carcinoma (contrast BACH_0253); normal-lobule score is Unreliable.
3. **Regions 0–3, 8–11**: Inspect superior and inferior margins (108 um strips) for tumor; frozen-section stains not drafted.
